considerations: Vehicle access is available from Nick Young Rd through two driveways into a large paved parking lot that provides clear circulation and staging space. The site includes a large single-story metal building and several smaller detached buildings. Open dirt and gravel areas behind the buildings hold equipment and stored materials. The property sits in a mixed rural and industrial setting with neighboring storage yards, residences, and open dry fields. Scattered trees line portions of the road frontage.
